svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: Milligrams of total antibiotic use per kilogram of livestock. This is adjusted for differences in livestock numbers
and species by standardizing to a population-corrected unit (PCU).

tspan.tspan: Several small island states have been excluded as they are large anomalous outliers in the global dataset.
